## Appendix

### How to Generate This Report

```bash
# Navigate to project directory
cd /Users/aideveloper/AINativeStudio-IDE/ainative-studio

# Run tests with coverage
npm run test-node -- --coverage --grep "Skills Manager"

# View HTML coverage report
open .build/coverage/index.html

# Generate JSON report for CI/CD
npm run test-node -- --coverage --reporter=json > coverage-report.json
```

### Coverage Configuration

**Configuration File**: `.nycrc.json`

```json
{
  "all": true,
  "include": ["src/vs/workbench/contrib/void/**/skill*.ts"],
  "exclude": ["**/*.test.ts", "**/*.d.ts"],
  "check-coverage": true,
  "lines": 80,
  "functions": 80,
  "branches": 75,
  "statements": 80
}
```
